contracts.signal: Release detail beyond the call: AWS plans to deploy the additional 2 million NVIDIA GPUs - Blackwell Ultra, Rubin and Rubin Ultra - in 2027-2028 across AWS Global Infrastructure, after demand exceeded the more than 1 million GPUs AWS announced at GTC 2026. AWS and NVIDIA plan to build AI factories for the U.S. government, including 100,000 GPUs on secure AWS infrastructure for federal and national-security workloads (Impact Level 6 and above). AWS will expand Blackwell capacity with RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs in EC2 G7 instances (AWS the first major cloud to offer them; 4.6x AI inference performance vs G6), and the companies collaborate on Spectrum networking. Jensen Huang: 'demand is running ahead of every forecast'.
contracts.units: 2 million additional GPUs in 2027-2028; 100,000 GPUs for U.S. government AI factories

contracts.signal: NVIDIA and Amazon's Annapurna Labs are extending AWS's support for NVLink Fusion in next-generation Trainium chips to NVIDIA's new custom high-bandwidth memory (NVHBM), in partnership with memory suppliers - giving Trainium access to faster, more power-efficient memory and integrating Trainium and GPUs within a common rack-scale architecture.
